name: @wxyc/auth-log-prune
description: Daily EC2-cron auth-log prune (BS#2363, extended by BS#2536): delete station_signup_attempt rows older than the 30-day audit retention window (pruneSignupAttempts) and account_audit_event rows older than ACCOUNT_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS (default 730, pruneAccountAuditEvents), under separate try/catch blocks so one table's prune failure cannot silently skip the other's. Never touches station_passcode. Split from jobs/station-signup-review because the failure consequences differ -- a failed prune just grows the table, a failed review is a silent queue and a security gap -- and those want separate alerting.
